english.title: Food business operator transporting or refining raw sugar fail to consider cleaning process as critical control point

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: food safety and hygiene England regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a food business operator who was responsible for the transport or refining of raw sugar, in fulfilling the obligations under Article 5(1) of Regulation 852/2004 in relation to the bulk transport of raw sugar by sea under paragraph 7 of Schedule 3 to the Food Safety and Hygiene (England) Regulations 2013, failed to consider the cleaning process undertaken prior to the loading of the sugar for transport by sea to be a critical control point as referred to in Article 5(2)(b) of Regulation 852/2004
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 13(a) of Schedule 3 to, and regulation 19(2) of, the Food Safety and Hygiene (England) Regulations 2013.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
